claims.claim: The notice must include the event dates or period.
claims.quote: the period (not exceeding [ F2 168 hours ] ) during which it is proposed to use the premises for those activities
claims.note: The statute requires the event period.

claims.claim: The notice must include the times of licensable activities.
claims.quote: the times during the event period when the premises user proposes that those licensable activities shall take place
claims.note: The statute requires the proposed times.

claims.claim: The notice must include the event activities.
claims.quote: the licensable activities to which the proposal mentioned in subsection (1) relates
claims.note: The statute requires the relevant licensable activities.

claims.claim: The notice must include the number of attendees.
claims.quote: the maximum number of persons (being a number less than 500) which the premises user proposes should, during those times, be allowed on the premises at the same time
claims.note: The statute requires a maximum concurrent person count.
